scope: Ordered current projection and source lifecycle
Full BRB/WHAM configuration composition at finite targets
verification.evidence_ceiling: Named geometry, lifecycle and configuration cases only; no arbitrary-input scientific correctness or release claim.
known_limitations: No experimental validation of source device constants, conductor area proxy or material magnetization is claimed.
Direct geometry/weight arrays can be mutated; cache content changes are detected, but mutation that desynchronizes parameterized geometry from its parameters is outside the supported contract.
Unknown **kwargs are permissive where inherited; no arbitrary keyword semantic claim.
Plotting/patch, simplify/clone, multiprocessing, electrodes and persistent sweeps are excluded or unresolved.
No scientific, experimental or licensing approval is claimed.

summary: Construct the fixed BRB source composition: two 88-point TREX coils, two 130-point rectangular coils, and 36 signed 16-point rings.

identity.direction: configuration constructor to ordered child sources
identity.definition: BRB registers two TREXCoil, two RectangularCoil, and thirty-six MagnetRing children in attribute order.
identity.model: Axisymmetric ideal circular-filament geometry with declared constants.
identity.geometry: Ordered child source geometries in cylindrical R,Z coordinates.
identity.coordinates: R,Z in metres; currents in amperes; ring weights dimensionless; angles in degrees.
identity.boundary: The object is a geometry composition and does not calibrate an experimental device or material response.
assumptions: Child sources use the ideal circular-filament response.
Field evaluation still requires a finite nonsingular target mesh.

outputs.name: source
outputs.description: Constructed BRB object with source geometry, common currents, weights and optional target mesh. Fields are evaluated by its methods.
outputs.units: geometry m; current A; weights dimensionless
outputs.constraints: Bounded source geometry and field-response methods

preconditions: Child sources use the ideal circular-filament response.
supported: Child order and counts, mesh propagation, current projection, and finite nonsingular field evaluation.
excluded: Experimental calibration, finite-wire or permeability physics, cathode/anode additions, and persistent sweeps.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: BRB construction or child field evaluation propagates the child source ValueError/FloatingPointError semantics; excluded additions raise NotImplementedError.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Green-kernel numerical failures propagate from a child source.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; the configuration is a direct ordered composition.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Construction failure does not return a usable configuration; child registration is performed by the constructor.

example.description: Construct BRB and inspect the named child counts.
example.code:
from scirel.configurations import BRB
d=BRB()
assert len(d.current_sets)==40
assert d.hh_n.npts==88
example.expected: The device has 40 registered children and hh_n has 88 filament points.
